scope: Proofpress v2 Git-backed event replay implementation

observed_problem.description: v2_events launched one git show subprocess for every event object. Repeated CLI operations therefore incurred process-launch overhead proportional to the full ledger on every call.
observed_problem.effect: local runtime only; event bytes, order, IDs, commits, projections, model calls, and experiment semantics are unchanged.

correction.description: Resolve all commit:event.json objects through one git cat-file --batch process, then decode them in the original rev-list order.
semantic_invariants: event JSON and commit association are unchanged
task, treatment, models, prompts, caps, policy verdicts, and evaluators are unchanged

historical_attempts: preserved; no task or model generation was restarted to apply this implementation optimization
outcome_blinding: frozen before GPT MSA or GPT License produced paired receiver quality results
